The 2013 uniform-operator treatment, later modified-knot/multidimensional literature and targeted database results do not state a covering theorem. Classical half-grid sine diagonalization is a tool and not separately claimed new; the priority of any hidden exact formula remains uncertain.

value.rationale: This is an exact spectrum and precise n⁻² spectral-gap limit for the natural degree-two Greville positive spline operator, addressing the stated fixed-degree spectral conjecture in a substantive nontrivial case and providing a sharp asymptotic for iterate-error decay. It is not merely an unrelated finite tridiagonal example; the operator-to-Jacobi reduction, eigenfunction basis and norm limit connect approximation and spectral theory.
